newsitem.title: USA: Salomon stake increased by Dart Financial.
newsitem.headline: Salomon stake increased by Dart Financial.

text.p: Dart Financial Corp said on Friday it increased its stake in Salomon Inc to 6.31 percent, from 5.2 percent.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Dart said it bought 1,165,800 additional shares of the Wall Street investment firm between December 3 and 11 at an average price of $44.87 each.
Dart Financial is a private trust company affiliated with Dart Container Corp, a Mason, Mich.,-based maker of polystyrene cups, and plastic cutlery and dinnerware.
The latest purchases were made through Ross Financial Corp, one of Dart Financial's affiliates.
Dart Financial said it holds the stake for long-term, passive investment purposes.
On November 12, Dart Financial said it held 5,472,500 common shares in Salomon.
